# Before the head-touch product transition

These five public product files are byte-for-byte copies from `efc8db9cb`.
They freeze the old Voice, Expression, Controls and Body units and their
pins for the #2948 updater transition controls. The controls originated in
Third's public review receipt `f99783904`; the proposed pins are constructed
by removing only `legacy_head` from this frozen input, independent of the
current product defaults. They contain no lamp's private settings.
